state.row_5_10_as_committed: 5.10 (pending, Needs 5.8, added 8 Nov by user decision): The Editor's publish reads the engine's declared locality from the capability exchange and publishes through gx_asset_plane::publish_package: co-located, it writes a package into the configured package directory and hands it over by path; over a LAN, it uploads chunked. An Editor-path test publishes the Inter lower third both ways to real workers, and both are taken.
verified_constraints: Boundary rule R6 (invariant 4): Editor-side crates (Editor/shell, services/editor, mocks/mock-editor) never depend on a control-plane client. So no Editor code can run the capability exchange, where EngineCapability.locality is declared.
5.7 (done): the control port authorises only Role::Playout connections (message.rs authorise). The Editor holds no Playout token.

R9: no consumer branches on Locality outside contracts, control-plane, media-plane, asset-plane, render-engine, mock-engine and conformance. gx_asset_plane::handoff_for(locality) is the one negotiation (LocalPath | ChunkedUpload); publish_package(engine, locality, package_path) is the one publisher and needs a .gpxpkg on disk for both routes.
5.8 user decisions: the publisher is configured with the engine's package directory; nothing about the directory goes on the wire or into EngineCapability.

The engine declares locality in one field (Engine.locality, --lan or not); the asset plane today answers scene, fetch, package and the transfer dialect, and no locality request. Both ports bind 127.0.0.1; --lan only changes the declaration.

The Editor publishes today through cmd_publish -> publish_with_assets (5.9): chunked upload of the scene's verified import-cache bytes, then the scene. gx-editor (services/editor) already depends on gx-asset-plane; conformance depends on gx-editor and may hold a control client, so it can take.
write_package requires scene.revision = Some and a source for every scene asset; the engine issues its own revision and the content hash ignores the top-level revision.
state.recommended_design: The engine answers a new closed asset-plane read {locality:{}} from the same field it declares as EngineCapability.locality (new required AssetPublishPeer::locality, no default). gx_asset_plane::publish_as_package(engine, folder, scene, sources) reads that locality, writes one verified package named by content hash/pid/sequence into the Editor's package folder, calls publish_package, and removes the package after the reply. The publish logic moves into gx_editor::publish so cmd_publish and conformance call the same function; Editor code never names a Locality. Folder: GX_EDITOR_PACKAGE_DIR, else platform::package_exchange_root(); the launcher and gx-engine-host give a co-located engine the same folder as --package-dir. Hardening: a LAN-declared peer never reads a package path (shared server rule) and gx-render-worker refuses --lan with --package-dir. Conformance holds each peer's asset-plane answer equal to EngineCapability.locality on two real workers and both mocks, publishes the Inter lower third both ways, takes both (Taken on T0), and drives named refusals and mutations.

alternatives.relay: Zero new wire: a launcher or gx-engine-host --describe reads EngineCapability over the control plane and passes it to the Editor in an environment variable; goes stale on restart, and a real LAN engine needs hand configuration.
alternatives.r6_carveout: Amend R6 and 5.7 for a read-only Editor capability client with a new role; keeps the row wording literally, weakens invariant 4's structural enforcement.
alternatives.editor_setting: An Editor setting for locality: a second declaration that can disagree silently.

locality_source.instructions: Where should the Editor learn the engine's declared locality, given R6 and 5.7?

criteria.asset_plane_read: A new one-field asset-plane read {locality:{}}, answered from the engine's single locality field and held equal to EngineCapability.locality by conformance.
criteria.relay: A zero-wire relay through the launcher or engine host, passed to the Editor as configuration.
criteria.r6_carveout: Amend R6 and 5.7 so the Editor may hold a read-only capability client.
criteria.editor_setting: An Editor configuration setting for the locality.

no_wire_scope.instructions: Does the 5.8 decision 'nothing about the directory goes on the wire or into EngineCapability' also forbid a new asset-plane locality read?

criteria.directory_only: No: it is scoped to the package directory; a locality read adds no directory and no EngineCapability field.
criteria.all_new_wire: Yes: it forbids any new wire request.

reword_row.instructions: Must row 5.10's text be reworded before it is built, since 'reads the engine's declared locality from the capability exchange' cannot be executed by Editor code under R6 and 5.7?

criteria.true: Yes, reword it to the design that will be built, by user decision.
criteria.false: No, build to the current text.

test_home.instructions: Where does the 'Editor-path test ... both are taken' run, given the Editor shell may not hold a control client even in tests?

criteria.conformance_calls_gx_editor: Conformance calls gx_editor::publish (the function cmd_publish calls) and takes there; the shell test covers routes and refusals without a take.
criteria.shell_in_conformance: Add the Tauri shell crate as a conformance dependency and call it directly.
criteria.no_take: Assert only the publication, take nowhere.

lan_hardening.instructions: Harden the engine so a LAN-declared engine never reads a package path?

criteria.both: A shared asset-plane server rule (LAN-declared peer has no effective directory) and the worker refusing --lan with --package-dir at startup.

co_located_without_dir.instructions: What happens when the Editor publishes to a co-located engine started without --package-dir (5.9's chunked publish worked there)?

criteria.named_refusal: Refused by name (PackageDirectoryNotConfigured); the launcher and engine host pass --package-dir.
criteria.worker_default_dir: The worker defaults its package directory to a platform folder when co-located.
criteria.fallback_chunked: The Editor falls back to the chunked upload.

folder_config.instructions: Where is the Editor's package folder configured?

criteria.env_plus_platform_default: GX_EDITOR_PACKAGE_DIR if set, else platform::package_exchange_root(); no UI write path.
criteria.ui_parameter: A cmd_publish parameter and a UI field.
criteria.settings_file: A new per-machine Editor settings file.

behaviour_changes.instructions: The Editor then always packages: an asset with no content hash is refused PackageAssetNotPackaged, the shell's old publish_with_assets route is retired, and 5.9's co-located behaviour changes. How is that recorded?

criteria.accept_and_note_5_9: Accept all, and add a note to row 5.9 saying co-located publishes now go by path.
criteria.accept_evidence_only: Accept the code changes but record them only in docs/evidence/5.10.
criteria.keep_two_routes: Keep publish_with_assets as a second route.

evidence_bar.instructions: Is a loopback worker started with --lan acceptable as the 'LAN' worker, with the row done only when both takes are Taken on the T0 workstation (a named TierTooLow skip below T0)?

criteria.true: Yes, defer; 5.10 adds only the locality read.
